## Summary
2026-07-08: dedicated booking flow live since May 2026. Clubs report fewer phone bookings.

## Facts
- Wheelchair spaces are held back from general sale and booked with a free companion ticket.
- Proof of eligibility is checked once per season by the club's disability liaison officer, not per booking.
- Kingsport FC holds 140 wheelchair spaces, Harbour Athletic 96, Vale Rovers 48.

## Known issues
- Held-back spaces that are not booked often stay empty on matchday; there is no rule yet for releasing them to general sale.
